# Ashwi Furniture

> Premium Handcrafted Furniture in Kathmandu, Nepal with 100% Payment After Delivery.

## About Ashwi Furniture
Ashwi Furniture is a Kathmandu-based furniture manufacturer and showroom offering beautifully finished, durable home and office furniture. Customers inspect furniture upon home delivery before making payment.

## Quick Facts
- **Location**: Kathmandu, Nepal (Coordinates: 27.7172° N, 85.3240° E)
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +977 986-0479751 (Direct orders & inquiries)
- **Website**: https://www.ashwifurniture.com
- **Payment Model**: 100% Payment After Delivery (Cash on Delivery, Fonepay, Bank Transfer)
- **Delivery**: Free delivery & installation inside Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur. Shipping across Nepal.
- **Warranty**: 5-10 years structural frame warranty.
